LG/SM F3 intercross: relationship matrix

Source: R/data.R
lgsm_A.Rd

The additive relationship matrix of the 1611 F3 mice of lgsm_f3, from lgsm_pedigree with the F2 parents as unrelated, non-inbred founders: 1 on the diagonal, 1/2 between full sibs, 1/4 between half sibs (sires with more than one mate) and 0 otherwise. The four sires missing in the source come from the markers (lgsm_f3$sire_inferred).

Usage

lgsm_A

Format

A 1611 x 1611 numeric matrix with the F3 IDs (as character) as row and column names, in the order of lgsm_f3$ID. It is positive definite (smallest eigenvalue 1/2). Take the rows and columns of the mice in an analysis, as fit_G() and indri_gwas() match by name.

Source

Built by data-raw/lgsm.R from lgsm_pedigree.

Examples

table(lgsm_A[upper.tri(lgsm_A)])
#> 
#>       0    0.25     0.5 
#> 1289838     752    6265
